name: toolbox
description: Hugo's dev & productivity toolbox: code explanation, dependency version checks, Java/Spring documentation (Javadoc/OpenAPI/ADR), best-practices review, JUnit test generation, PR description generation, a pre-PR readiness check, Bitbucket PR review from a URL (interactive walkthrough or autonomous), smart session compaction, and a brag book kept in Notion from sessions, commits, Jira, Bitbucket and Confluence.
